name: Whirlpool/KA ACU French Door Cabinet Thermistor
failureModes: In range but warm zone — damper (test 3), ice box fan (test 36), or sealed system
testingTips: Enter Service Diagnostics: SW1+SW2 ×3 sec until chime; display shows 01
FC thermistor P5-3/P5-4; RC P5-1/P5-2; ice box P8-1/P8-2 — 1.5–5 VDC when powered
Measure at harness with power disconnected for bench ohms

name: Whirlpool/KA ACU French Door Defrost Heater
purpose: 365 W ±5% heater — 36.2 Ω ±5% @ 115 VAC. Service test 6 energizes heater when bimetal closed.
failureModes: Open — no defrost; heavy freezer evap frost
Good ohms but no heat in test 6 — ACU relay or open bimetal
testingTips: Bypass open bimetal only for live heater verification in test 6

name: Whirlpool/KA ACU French Door Defrost Bimetal
purpose: Opens above 42°F/5.6°C ±5°; closes below 12°F/-11°C ±7°. Spec table lists 56 kΩ across terminals when open.
failureModes: Open when evaporator frosted — no defrost heat path
Stuck closed — extended defrost or heater timeout
testingTips: Must read closed (few Ω) on cold/frosted evaporator

name: Whirlpool/KA ACU French Door Compressor Run Winding (EMD55CLT)
purpose: EMD55CLT run winding 5.3 Ω ±8%. Service test 4 toggles compressor/condenser fan with SW3.
failureModes: Open winding — compressor silent; relay may click
Run OK but no start — check start winding, relay, 12 µfd cap
testingTips: FLA 2.3 A ±5%; LRA 11.3 A ±5%; run cap 12 µfd ±10%

name: Whirlpool/KA ACU French Door Compressor Start Winding (EMD55CLT)
purpose: Start winding 7.7 Ω ±8% @ 77°F. Run capacitor 12 µfd ±10% @ 180 VAC.
failureModes: Relay TSD or 12 µfd cap failure with good windings
testingTips: Test relay and run capacitor before condemning compressor
Condenser fan 940 RPM clockwise; 2.6 W @ 115 VAC

name: Whirlpool/KA ACU French Door Ice Maker Mold Thermistor
purpose: Ice maker mold thermistor P7-1/P7-2 — same R/T chart as cabinet NTC. Service test 58 digit 2: 2=open, 3=short. E5 = thermistor fault.
failureModes: Open or short — E5 on service test 56
Good ohms but E3 heater timeout — mold heater or harvest logic
testingTips: Run test 57 harvest before test 45 water fill
